rationale: The original thesis remains fully intact as TSCO continues to consolidate tightly in the upper decile of today's range (92.6%) while holding above the rising 5-minute 9-EMA ($34.17) and well above session VWAP ($32.63). Despite pulling back from an intra-trade high of ~0.87% MFE, price is finding support around $34.20 with exceptional relative strength against a weak broader market (SPY -1.44%) on 3.55x relative volume. With 64 minutes remaining in the session, holding for a potential retest of the $34.55 target remains the highest-expectancy play while the $33.85 invalidation protects downside.
